claims.statement: A first-time owner or coding agent can run one harness-neutral command that verifies the installed using-sensemaking Skill, prepares a handoff artifact for a target repository, and hands off to the single Skill entrypoint without pretending the CLI performs semantic analysis.

attributes.title: Verified first-use handoff

origin.author: Sensemaking construction agent under the 2026-11-27 delegated mission

alignment.basis: ADR 0034 makes using-sensemaking the single semantic entrypoint. A handoff that verifies the installed Skill and prepares a prompt preserves that boundary rather than adding a second analyzer.

ambition.basis: A small user-facing bridge from installation to the existing Skill workflow, not a new cognitive engine.

horizon.basis: The setup-skills install record, harness adapter roots and bounded path inventory already exist; the missing piece is a verified handoff.

realization.basis: The current analyze command is a print-only stub that names one harness and hardcodes an artifact path. No verified handoff artifact or independent first-use observation exists.

disposition_history.authority: agent-authored synthesis under current delegated mission
disposition_history.rationale: Combines the installed-Skill setup and install-record surface, the single using-sensemaking entrypoint and the observed false affordance in the public analyze command. The handoff is a mechanical bridge, not a second semantic controller.

attributes.synthesis_basis: Combines the installed-Skill setup and install-record surface, the single using-sensemaking entrypoint and the observed false affordance in the public analyze command. The handoff is a mechanical bridge, not a second semantic controller.
attributes.value_hypothesis: A verified first-use handoff reduces failed installation-to-Skill transitions and stale-Skill load, helping a first-time agent reach a source-grounded answer faster.
attributes.revisit_when: An independent first-time user reports whether the handoff reached a source-grounded answer, or the handoff implementation changes: file:src/sensemaking_skills/first_use.py or file:src/sensemaking_skills/cli.py.
attributes.counterevidence: The real entrypoint is the Skill; a launcher may add a second surface and may not be used by users who read GETTING_STARTED. A generated prompt may not improve the agent's answer.
attributes.claim_ceiling: One handoff implementation and one same-agent first-use exercise. It does not establish that users start with the CLI, that the handoff improves answer quality, or that independent users reach a source-grounded answer.
